# REST Client Property Reference

Generated from the compiled `RestClientProperties` configuration property class. OAuth2 provider, registration, client id, client secret, grant type, token URI, and requested scopes are owned by Spring Boot under `spring.security.oauth2.client.*`.

<!-- generated by ./gradlew generatePropertyReferences; do not edit this file manually. -->

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.client-assertions.<registration-id>.custom-claims.*` | `Map&lt;String, Object&gt;` | `empty` | Provider-specific custom claims added to the client assertion. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.client-assertions.<registration-id>.key-store-id` | `String` | `empty` | Signing keystore id for private_key_jwt client authentication. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.client-assertions.<registration-id>.token-lifetime` | `Duration` | `1m` | Client assertion JWT lifetime. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.credentials.<id>.base64` | `String` | `empty` | Base64-encoded credential value resolved by *-ref properties. Takes priority over value; whitespace is ignored before decoding. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.credentials.<id>.value` | `String` | `empty` | Plain credential value resolved by *-ref properties such as password-ref, key-password-ref, username refs, and password refs. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.diagnostics.enabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Emits structured OAuth2 token diagnostic events through logging-core. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.diagnostics.include-cache-events` | `boolean` | `true` | Emits authorized-client cache hit, miss, skip, and save events when diagnostics are enabled. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.diagnostics.include-claims` | `boolean` | `false` | Includes sanitized assertion claims and authorization attributes in diagnostics. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.diagnostics.include-token-preview` | `boolean` | `false` | Includes a truncated token or assertion prefix followed by ...<redacted>. Keep disabled outside controlled debugging. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.diagnostics.token-preview-length` | `int` | `24` | Number of leading characters to include when token preview is enabled. Minimum effective value is 8. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.jwt-bearer.<registration-id>.audience` | `String` | `empty` | JWT bearer assertion audience (aud). Defaults to the provider token URI when empty. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.jwt-bearer.<registration-id>.custom-claims.*` | `Map&lt;String, Object&gt;` | `empty` | Provider-specific custom JWT bearer claims. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.jwt-bearer.<registration-id>.issuer` | `String` | `empty` | JWT bearer assertion issuer (iss). Defaults to the client registration client id when empty. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.jwt-bearer.<registration-id>.key-store-id` | `String` | `empty` | Signing keystore id for urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.jwt-bearer.<registration-id>.subject` | `String` | `empty` | JWT bearer assertion subject (sub). Defaults to the client registration client id when empty. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.jwt-bearer.<registration-id>.token-lifetime` | `Duration` | `5m` | JWT bearer assertion lifetime. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.key-stores.<id>.base64` | `String` | `empty` | Inline base64 keystore or truststore content. Takes priority over location. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.key-stores.<id>.key-alias` | `String` | `empty` | Private key alias for signing or mTLS. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.key-stores.<id>.key-password` | `String` | `empty` | Inline private key password. Falls back to the resolved store password when empty. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.key-stores.<id>.key-password-ref` | `String` | `empty` | Credential id for the private key password. The referenced credential may use value or base64, and may differ from the store password. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.key-stores.<id>.location` | `String` | `empty` | Resource or file location for a keystore or truststore. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.key-stores.<id>.password` | `String` | `empty` | Inline store password used to load the JKS or PKCS12 container. Prefer password-ref. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.key-stores.<id>.password-ref` | `String` | `empty` | Credential id for the store password. The referenced credential may use value or base64. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.key-stores.<id>.type` | `String` | `PKCS12` | Store type, usually PKCS12 or JKS. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.token-cache.client-credentials` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the starter-managed Spring OAuth2 authorized client service caches client_credentials access tokens. |
| `smbtech.rest-clients.authentication.token-cache.jwt-bearer` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the starter-managed Spring OAuth2 authorized client service caches JWT bearer grant access tokens. Dynamic custom claims are part of the cache identity when enabled. |
